title: Professional Email Terms: Proration of a Seat Catch-Up
content:
**Clause.** The catch-up fraction of a Professional Email seat catch-up turns on where the term stands today:

(a) where the term end date has passed and its renewal is still due, the seats went unbilled for the whole term, so the fraction is 1;

(b) where the term runs one calendar month and from 1 up to 14 days are left, the fraction is the whole weeks left, each counted as seven days, divided by the calendar days of the term, Harborline's short-month convention;

(c) otherwise the fraction is the calendar days from today to the term end date divided by the calendar days of the term.

## Edges on a one-month term (hypothetical 31-day month)

| Days left to the term end date | Paragraph | Fraction |
|---|---|---|
| 15 | (c) | 15 divided by 31 |
| 14 | (b) | 14 divided by 31 |
| 13 | (b) | 7 divided by 31 |
| 6 | (b) | none, 0 divided by 31 |
| term end date passed, renewal still due | (a) | 1 |

On a 12-month term the short-month convention never applies: 9 days left of a 365-day term give 9 divided by 365.
